title: My Chromebook is really slow
summary: Everything is laggy, or typing and scrolling are delayed.

steps.title: Close extra tabs
instructions: Close every tab and app you aren't using right now.
steps.question: Is it faster now?

steps.title: Use Task Manager
instructions: Press the Search key and the Esc key at the same time. This opens Task Manager.
Click the Memory footprint column to see what is using the most memory.
Click a tab or app you don't need, then click End process.
steps.question: Is it faster now?

steps.title: Install updates
instructions: Click the time in the bottom-right corner of the screen.
If you see "Restart to update", click it. Updates are safe.
If you don't see it, answer No.
steps.question: Did it update, and is it faster now?

steps.title: Turn it off and on again
instructions: Press and hold the power button until the screen goes dark.
Wait 10 seconds, then press the power button once to turn it back on.
steps.question: Is it faster now?

steps.title: Test with one tab
instructions: Open just one tab and use it for a few minutes.
If it is only slow when many tabs are open, try keeping fewer tabs open.
steps.question: Is it still very slow with only one tab open?
